\section{Method}
\label{sec:method}
\subsection{Scores}
We compute scores
\begin{equation}
  S = \frac{Q K^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \label{eq:score}
\end{equation}
and normalize them with a softmax, as in Eq.~\eqref{eq:score} and \cref{eq:max,eq:exp}.

\begin{align}
  m &= \max_j S_{ij} \label{eq:max} \\
  t &= S_{ij} - m \nonumber \\
  p_{ij} &= e^{t} \label{eq:exp}
\end{align}

\begin{equation*}
  \sum_j p_{ij} = 1
\end{equation*}
\subsubsection{Stability}
We pick $\hat{y} = \argmax_y p(y)$ and $\eps = 0.1$ in $\R^{d}$.
\[ z = \vect{x} + 1 \]
